title: Semiconductor Device Modeling Software — Overview and definition
t: Semiconductor Device Modeling Software — Overview and definition
description: Simulates transistor physics from doping profiles to I-V and capacitance.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Simulates transistor physics from doping profiles to I-V and capacitance. Semiconductor device modeling software solves Poisson, drift-diffusion, and hydrodynamic equations on device meshes to predict I-V, C-V, breakdown, and hot-carrier effects. Real implementations include Silvaco Atlas, Synopsys Sentaurus TCAD, and the open DEVSIM. It calibrates mobility, recombination, and quantum-correction models to measured data.

body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Semiconductor Device Modeling Software, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Drift-diffusion and hydrodynamic transport solvers). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Drift-diffusion and hydrodynamic transport solvers and Process-to-device coupling from doping profiles. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Integrated circuit layout editor) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
